```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: registry
spec:
  selector:
    app: registry
  ports:
    - port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: registry
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: registry
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: registry
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: registry
          image: descartesresearch/teastore-registry
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: USE_POD_IP
              value: "true"
            - name: SERVICE_PORT
              value: "8080"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 1Gi
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 30
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: db
spec:
  selector:
    app: db
  ports:
    - port: 3306
      targetPort: 3306
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: db
spec:
  serviceName: db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: db
          image: descartesresearch/teastore-db
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3306
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 1Gi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/mysql
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3306
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 30
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3306
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3306
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: db-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 2Gi
---

    spec:

        - name: persistence

          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: HOST_NAME
              value: "persistence"
            - name: USE_POD_IP
              value: "true"
            - name: REGISTRY_HOST
              value: "registry"
            - name: REGISTRY_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: SERVICE_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: "db"
            - name: DB_PORT
              value: "3306"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m

          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 30
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
```
